method.visual_review: Actual original RGB source samples viewed in aspect-ratio-preserving contact sheets; listed follow-ups viewed as full native frames. All 22 G12 and all 68 G33 samples have exact RGB equality checks against cached original decoded frames.
method.cropping: G12 sheet ROI [150,0,1770,1080]; G33 sheet ROI [420,0,1500,720]. Isotropic resizing only. Character dark pixels in these height ranges checked to remain within horizontal crop. G33 lower legs intentionally outside upper-body comparison.
method.transform_scope: Uniform scale + translation + canvas crop. No same-art transform established for these 22.
